text: Viability is the ability to survive and develop successfully. An egg with good viability is healthy enough to be fertilised and grow into a baby.
Plummeted means fell suddenly and steeply. A woman's supply of immature eggs drops from millions before birth to a few hundred thousand by puberty.
Unprecedented means never having happened before. The specialist says fixing egg errors at the source could bring gains no earlier IVF technique has offered.
IVF is a medical process where eggs are fertilised by sperm in a lab dish, and the resulting embryo is placed in the womb. “In vitro” is Latin for “in glass”.
Fit-for-purpose means good enough to do the job it was made for. Saying IVF is not fit-for-purpose for older women means it often fails them.
A gamble is a risky bet where you may lose. IVF is called a gamble because it costs a lot and may not work.
Heartbreaking means causing deep sadness. Failed IVF attempts can be heartbreaking for hopeful parents.
To tolerate something is to put up with it, even if it is hard or unpleasant. Here, patients must be able to endure the cost, pain, and stress of treatment.
A burden is a heavy load, whether physical, financial, or emotional. The article lists all three for IVF patients.
As it stands means in its present state, without any changes. The sentence says IVF today, as it is now, is not good enough.
A startup is a young company, often built around a new idea or technology and usually not yet making a profit.
To peer is to look closely or with effort. Here scientists studied the inside of a human egg in great detail.
Error-prone means likely to make mistakes. Egg development becomes error-prone as a woman ages.
Faulty means having a defect or fault, so that it does not work properly. A faulty egg has chromosome errors.
An oocyte is an immature egg cell in the ovary. The article explains that oocytes are formed before a woman is born.
A fetus is a baby developing in the womb. A woman's eggs are formed while she herself is a fetus.
Ovarian reserve is the stock of eggs a woman has left in her ovaries. It peaks before birth and shrinks over the years.
Puberty is the stage of life when a child's body becomes capable of reproduction, usually around ages 10 to 14.
Depleted means used up or greatly reduced. By menopause a woman's egg supply is almost depleted.
Menopause is the time in a woman's life, usually around 50, when monthly periods stop and she can no longer have children naturally.
Chromosomes are tightly packed strands of DNA inside cells that carry genes. Humans normally have 23 pairs.
Abnormal means different from what is normal or expected. Eggs with abnormal numbers of chromosomes are unlikely to produce healthy babies.
In cells, chromosomes come as matching pairs, one inherited from each parent. Making an egg means splitting each pair so only one of each remains.
Discarded means thrown away. In making an egg, half the chromosomes are discarded so that the egg keeps one complete set.
A sperm is the male reproductive cell. It joins with an egg to start a pregnancy.
Aneuploid describes a cell with too many or too few chromosomes; aneuploidy is the condition. It is a leading cause of infertility and miscarriage.
A leading cause is one of the most important reasons something happens.
Infertility is difficulty in having a baby despite trying. It can have many causes.
Mapping out means working out and recording the details of something step by step, like drawing a map. Here the scientists traced the molecular causes.
Cohesin is a molecule that acts like glue holding chromosome pairs together as an egg develops. Its levels fall with age.
Choreography is the planned sequence of dance moves. Here it is a metaphor: chromosomes must move and line up in a precise order.
Diminished means made smaller or weaker. With less cohesin, the process of dividing chromosomes goes wrong.
Shugoshin 1 is a protein that protects cohesin from decaying. Its name comes from a Japanese word meaning “guardian spirit”.
A guardian spirit is a protective being in folklore. The name fits a protein that guards the cohesin glue.
Decay means a gradual breakdown. Cohesin's decay lets chromosome pairs come apart too soon.
Turning into means changing into something else. Here a healthy egg cell can turn into an aneuploid one.
EmbryoProtect 1 is the product Ovo Labs is developing, based on Shugoshin 1, to be injected into immature egg cells.
A control group is a comparison group that does not get the treatment. Comparing it with the treated group shows whether the treatment really works.
Promising means showing signs of future success, though nothing is certain yet.
Pups are the babies of animals such as mice, dogs, and seals.
Peer review means independent experts check a study before a journal publishes it. “Not yet peer reviewed” means that check has not happened.
To translate into practice means to move from lab discoveries to real treatments for patients. Clinical means involving actual patients.
Substantially means by a large amount, or to a great extent.
Separase is an enzyme, a protein that speeds up chemical reactions, that cuts proteins such as Shugoshin 1. Slowing it keeps more cohesin in place.
Here cleave means to split or cut apart. An enzyme that cleaves a protein chops it in two. (The word can also mean to cling, an unusual opposite meaning.)
Lyvanta is U-Ploid's molecule that slows separase, aiming to protect Shugoshin 1 and cohesin.
Incidence is how often something happens, or the share of cases affected.
Preliminary means early and not final. Preliminary results may change when more work is done.
Matured means grew into a fully developed state. Immature egg cells need to mature before they can be fertilised.
Engineered means designed and built by people. An engineered cohesin would be a man-made version of the natural molecule.
A counterpart is something that does a similar job to another. The engineered cohesin would help its natural counterpart.
Spindles are tiny structures of fibres inside a dividing cell that line up chromosomes and pull them apart.
Unstable means likely to change, fall apart, or fail. Human egg spindles are unusually unstable.
Mammals are warm-blooded animals that feed their young milk, such as humans, mice, cows, and pigs.
KIFC-1 is a protein that stabilises spindles. Human eggs have very low levels compared with those of mice, cows, and pigs.
Here an avenue means a possible route or approach to explore, not a street.
To caution is to warn someone to be careful. The expert praises the data but warns that safety must be proven.
Efficacy is how well a treatment works. A treatment must show both safety and efficacy in clinical trials.
Preclinical research is done in labs and on animals before any tests on patients.
A veteran is someone with long experience in a field.
Fixing a problem at the source means dealing with its root cause rather than its effects.
Clinical testing, or clinical trials, means testing a treatment on volunteers in stages, first for safety and then for effectiveness.
To turn away is to refuse to accept someone. The researchers have more eager volunteers than trial places, and trials do not yet exist.
To get in early means to join at the start, before others. Here, women want to be among the first trial participants.
